## Checklist

- [ ] The change matches an approved design or clearly scoped issue.
- [ ] The implementation is small enough to explain and avoids speculative
      abstractions.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure modes.
- [ ] Formatting, linting, and tests pass.
- [ ] Learning documentation and mock-interview questions are included for a
      feature.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, local environment files, or generated caches are
      committed.
- [ ] The commit history uses meaningful conventional commits.
